result: Workload coverage, seed/final fingerprints and deployment provenance verified; cold telemetry gaps and supporting Actor reincarnations qualified below.

scope.excluded: 50-0 rollout pilot; its six saved Object identities are disjoint from accepted Objects.
scope.method: Local read-only artifact/schema/hash inspection and revalidation of saved seed proofs. No hosted calls, new workloads, tests or framework changes.

coverage.checks: Exact ordered cold/warm1..9 coverage; one seeded Object per role/cohort; matching intent/reference/result pairs; ordered client intervals. Saved continuations at 50-1 and 250-2 contain no duplicate workload attempts.

fingerprints.boundaryCounts: All 54 fixtures have size admissions/messages before measurement and size+10 afterward. All 36 Yielded fixtures also have matching attempts and zero ownership/work entries at both boundaries.

seeds.prefixCoverage: All 54 chains reach the exact size without overlapping acknowledged ranges. Four gaps totaling 24 inputs have persisted terminal-prefix proofs.
seeds.acknowledgedOnlyChecks: Saved fresh seed-resume version, matching acknowledged count, admissions/attempts and zero ownership/work entries.
seeds.quietCriterion: Final afterTurn equals seed size; quiet=true, alarm=null, watchdog={}. Point-in-time seed observation.

main.coldDefinition: Fresh main DO incarnation after reset on the confirmed measurement version; module code and the plain-JS reference were already loaded and primed.
main.criterion: Matching Object/module/runtime/version/generation constructor record on the cold RPC trace. Missing evidence does not fail workload completion.

tardieActors.qualification: Thread warm identities remain stable. Uniform warm continuity for all participating Actors is contradicted in these two cohorts. Actor constructors occur in lookup RPCs on separate alarm-related traces; interval overlap alone is not causal attribution.

provenance.wrappers: All accepted uploaded worker.mjs hashes match wrapper-v5 or wrapper-v6/v7 archives. Separate ./bench.mjs imports remain intact. Cold/warm method bodies are identical across used revisions for all six roles; later changes add seed-proof/serial-seed routes.

effect.head: 01c6222ccf74390848595633ef23410cbfa6983b
effect.mergeBaseMethod: git merge-base --all <head> <fetched-main>; full non-shallow commit history; exactly one result
effect.piNote: Pi has no Effect dependency; its manifest records the parent build CLI installation.
effect.upstreamBuildLimit: Recorded packages use TypeScript 6.0.3 compiler API emission; this audit checked hashes, not upstream typechecking.

provenance.originalOutputLimit: Base/control/pinned prepare intermediates have been overwritten. Their saved local bench copies, build manifests and uploaded-module verification remain available.

limits: Checks establish saved client evidence, not an independent capture of every request body or platform invocation.
Fingerprints are the original benchmark's 64-bit SHA-256 prefix over model-visible history. Complete canonical histories were not replayed.
Reset acknowledgements and runtime IDs alone do not exclude earlier alarm activation; four main cold constructor traces remain unconfirmed.
Telemetry collection/completeness, inferred missing CPU and full alarm completion are outside this workload audit. Incomplete telemetry is not a failed workload.

evidence.digestMethod: Each cohort digest is SHA-256 of LF-joined sorted task-relative path + NUL + file SHA-256 entries for samples, attempts, audits, order, window and the six final seed JSON receipts (11 files).
